title: playback.events.v1
description: One playback observation, as ingested by POST /v1/events/playback. The server computes counted, duration_ms, media_type and private; the client cannot set them. Emitted even when private=true, flagged, so every consumer can honour the rule: private events reach neither listening history nor recommendation features nor the friend feed.

event_id.description: Idempotency key. Client-supplied via PlaybackSubmission.eventId, else generated at ingest.

user_id.description: From the JWT, never from the request body.

media_type.description: From the catalogue row, not the request.

session_id.description: One per listening session (client-defined). Omitted when the client sent none.

counted.description: PlayCountingPolicy: ms_played >= 30000 OR ms_played >= duration_ms * 0.5. What is reported to contributing churches.

private.description: user_settings.private_session at ingest time. MUST be honoured by every consumer.

device.description: Free text from the client. Recommended values: web, ios, android. Not validated server-side (see drift K3).

client_ts.description: Client wall clock, ISO 8601 by convention. Not validated server-side.

server_ts.description: Ingest time. Authoritative for ordering within a key.
